items.summary: Create a strict, centralized category display-label mapping system in the frontend by introducing a `CATEGORY_LABELS` dictionary that maps category slugs to human-readable labels, and a single helper function that UI code must call to render category labels. The dictionary must include (at minimum) the exact mappings provided by the user: construction→Construction, agriculture→Agriculture, homeservices→Home Services, transport→Transport, homeimprovement→Home Improvement, specializedcleaning→Specialized Cleaning, generalservices→General Services, woodmetal→Wood & Metal Works, treework→Tree Cutting & Coconut Climbing, householdservices→Household Services, vehicleservices→Vehicle Services, tailoring→Tailoring, aariwork→Aari Work, catering→Cooking / Catering, eventservices→Event Services, printing→Printing & Flex, repair→Repair Services, electrical→Electrical, plumbing→Plumbing, painting→Painting, carpenter→Carpentry, welding→Welding. The helper must normalize incoming slugs (case/whitespace/punctuation tolerant) for lookup.

Enforce the rendering rules for category slugs across the UI: (1) the UI must never render the raw category slug string; (2) if the slug is not found in `CATEGORY_LABELS`, render a safe fallback that is capitalized words (human-readable), not the original raw slug; (3) database values and navigation/search params must remain unchanged (mapping is display-only).

Apply the strict category label mapping helper everywhere category slugs can become user-visible, specifically covering: Home page category cards, Search Results page titles and any category labels, Worker Profile page work/category badges, Live suggestions dropdown display text, and category/filter UI (including any chips/buttons/headings that show category values). Replace any current usage that relies on auto-guessing (e.g., heuristics/title-casing directly on raw values) for category slugs with the centralized mapping helper.
